domains.title: Projects, scenes and persistence
domains.workflow: Create scene → configure → save → recover → package.
domains.risk: Data loss and broken references.

domains.title: Workspace, navigation and preferences
domains.workflow: Choose workspace → draw or animate → customize panels and shortcuts.
domains.risk: Professional density versus readability; ambiguous tool states.

domains.title: Layers, drawings and art sublayers
domains.workflow: Create layer → create drawing → expose → reuse or duplicate.
domains.risk: Confusing exposures, shared drawings and independent copies.

domains.title: Vector drawing and geometry editing
domains.workflow: Sketch → select → clean up → edit contours → finish drawing.
domains.risk: Topology, precision and stroke quality require engine work.

domains.title: Bitmap drawing, textures and brushes
domains.workflow: Draw bitmap → edit → manage resolution → exchange brushes.
domains.risk: Memory usage and consistency between texture and transform.

domains.title: Painting, palettes and color management
domains.workflow: Define palette → fill → correct → create variants → verify color.
domains.risk: Confusing color identity with RGB values and losing production consistency.

domains.title: Timeline, Xsheet and exposure
domains.workflow: Expose → adjust timing → play → review sheet.
domains.risk: A one-frame offset affects sound, drawing and rendering.

domains.title: Traditional and paperless animation
domains.workflow: Rough → tie-down → cleanup → paint → review.
domains.risk: Visual aids must never accidentally become exported artwork.

domains.title: Transforms, curves and keyframe animation
domains.workflow: Place keys → interpolate → adjust curves → reuse motion.
domains.risk: Matrix order, pivots and curve evaluation.

domains.title: Rigging, hierarchies and inverse kinematics
domains.workflow: Break down → set pivots → build hierarchy → add controls → pose.
domains.risk: Dependency cycles and pose jumps when changing hierarchies.

domains.title: Deformers and meshes
domains.workflow: Prepare rest pose → define influences → animate → evaluate → bake.
domains.risk: Deformation quality, self-intersections and complex textures.

domains.title: Advanced character controllers
domains.workflow: Capture poses → define controls → interpolate → package.
domains.risk: Pose interpolation does not invent drawings or resolve incompatible topology.

domains.title: Vector morphing
domains.workflow: Choose endpoints → establish correspondences → interpolate → correct.
domains.risk: Incompatible topologies, holes and degenerate strokes.

domains.title: Camera, staging and 2.5D space
domains.workflow: Position planes → frame shot → animate camera → check composition.
domains.risk: Projection and depth must agree across views.

domains.title: Compositing graph
domains.workflow: Connect inputs → group → configure parameters → preview → render.
domains.risk: Cycles, incorrect invalidation and confusion between layer order and topology.

domains.title: Effects, advanced compositing and shading
domains.workflow: Add effect → define bounds → animate parameters → verify output.
domains.risk: Color precision, alpha, tile edges and cumulative cost.

domains.title: Particles
domains.workflow: Emit → apply forces → display → bake.
domains.risk: Simulation must be reproducible and support scrubbing.

domains.title: Sound and lip sync
domains.workflow: Import sound → adjust → listen → detect and correct mouths.
domains.risk: Audiovisual drift, audio dropouts and imperfect detection.

domains.title: Import, scanning and interchange
domains.workflow: Import → verify conversions → link resources → correct losses.
domains.risk: A filename extension does not imply fidelity for every format feature.

domains.title: 3D integration
domains.workflow: Import model → adjust units → pose → composite with 2D.
domains.risk: Format compatibility, axes and external rendering cost.

domains.title: Preview, rendering and export
domains.workflow: Preview → set range and quality → render → verify.
domains.risk: Preview/output differences, encoder failures and memory exhaustion.

domains.title: Libraries, symbols and reuse
domains.workflow: Create asset → catalog → reuse → update.
domains.risk: Assets that appear independent but share data.

domains.title: Game output
domains.workflow: Prepare compatible rig → bake → export → validate runtime.
domains.risk: Not every node or deformer has a representation in game engines.

domains.title: Scripting and automation
domains.workflow: Automate edits → execute commands → batch process → integrate pipeline.
domains.risk: Executable external code and irreversible changes.

domains.title: Studio production and collaboration
domains.workflow: Assign scene → acquire rights → edit → version → deliver.
domains.risk: Multi-user and network conflicts; this is not CRDT co-editing.

domains.title: Optional AI assistance
domains.workflow: Select → configure provider → generate → compare → accept.
domains.risk: Service dependencies, model licenses and loss of creative control.
